summary: NO-SHIP: four release blockers remain. Two gates can still produce the exact false-green results the feature promises to prevent, the new always-loaded Writer Lane rule contradicts the enforced architecture, and the CI slice lacks end-to-end evidence.
triage: review-gate SKILL.md § Triage governs: render EVERY finding as a full table row, never inside a dialog; then ask the ROUND before the rows — take every Proposed decision as it stands, or decide row by row — and `as proposed` ends the round in that ONE action; only if row-by-row was chosen, ask per finding with that row's Proposed decision as the first option, a reject or defer taking a free-text reason; echo back ONLY the rows that carried free text, and none if the round was decided by selection alone; max 2 rounds, append decisions.md and COMMIT it with this artifact.

findings.title: Removing `needs: build` silently re-enables stale-artifact checks
findings.body: The table parser omits `needs`, although artifact isolation and `--artifacts` injection depend on that field. Changing any consumer in `scripts/gates.txt:43-49` from `build` to `-` therefore leaves parity green and makes it inspect fallback `.output/chrome-mv3`. The branch's own evidence at `docs/agents/verification.md:475-482` reproduces this false pass; only `manifest-gate` is separately pinned. This directly underimplements D4a's current-run-only artifact contract.
findings.recommendation: Add `needs` to the human table and compare it in `checkPlaces`; add data-driven mutation coverage for every `needs: build` consumer.

findings.title: Same-file accessibility replacements collapse to one fingerprint
findings.body: The identifier is only the leading element or attribute name, while the remaining key is rule plus filename. Removing one `autoFocus` violation and adding another in the same file preserves the bucket and count, so the gate passes. This is immediately reachable because the committed baseline contains seven `no-autofocus | rule-form.tsx | autoFocus` violations. It violates the spec's requirement that equal-total replacement regressions fail; the existing test only replaces diagnostics across files.
findings.recommendation: Use a stable discriminator such as an enclosing component/function or explicit suppression ID, and add a same-file, same-rule, same-count replacement fixture.

findings.title: The new Writer Lane instruction states a boundary that the code violates
findings.body: The always-loaded core says `WritePermit` never crosses a module boundary and exists only inside `StateWriter`. In the reviewed tree, `scripts/writer-lane-gate.mjs:107-114` explicitly permits it in four modules, while exported functions such as `stateStore.persistState` and `backupStore.clearCloudBackups` accept it. Agents are therefore told a data-loss invariant is enforced more narrowly than it is, undermining the central purpose of ticket 09.
findings.code:
- **Writer Lane** (ADR 0016) — 영속 저장소를 고치는 단 하나의 줄. 저장소를 고치는 경로는 **전부** 이
  줄을 지나며 한 번에 하나만 진행한다(어느 것들인지는 `CONTEXT.md`가 갖는다 — 여기 세어 두면 곧
  갈라선다). 팝업·탭 화면은 이 줄에 들어올 수 없고 메시지로 요청만 보낸다. 쓰기 허가(`WritePermit`)는
  쓰기 문(`StateWriter`) 구현 안에만 살고 **모듈 경계를 넘지 않는다**.
findings.recommendation: Either encapsulate permit-bearing persistence operations inside `StateWriter`, or rewrite AGENTS/CONTEXT/ADR and the gate to state the actual multi-module boundary precisely.

findings.title: The CI slice is closed without an actual GitHub Actions run
findings.body: The feature promises that fast gates run automatically in CI, but its committed evidence explicitly says the GitHub Actions path has never been observed. A Docker execution does not validate workflow triggering, action resolution, runner behavior, or the actual `ubuntu-latest` integration. The CI vertical slice is therefore proven only below its deployment seam.
findings.code:
**실제 GitHub Actions 실행은 아직 관측되지 않았다.** CI 경로는 **리눅스 컨테이너**(node:24 ·
bun 1.3.11)에서 `bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run gate:ci`로 12행 전부 PASS를 확인했다.
그러나 그것은 `ubuntu-latest` 러너가 아니다. 첫 실제 실행이 이 브랜치의 첫 PR에서 난다.
findings.recommendation: Require and record a successful `pull_request` workflow run on this branch before merge, then update the verification evidence.

next_steps: Fix the three contract defects and add the specified mutation tests.
Run the real GitHub Actions workflow and rerun the full hard gate set against the final tree.
Commit verification evidence that identifies the actual final reviewed tree.
